research.name: Generative Patterns
research.note: Browser-based generative pattern maker that layers translucent overlapping rectangles into seeded, downloadable images.

effects: Seeded generative compositions of overlapping translucent rotated rectangles in a single hue

unverified: The source is public in codebox/generative-patterns (MIT, 23 stars, last commit 2020-06-12); that repository has not yet been researched as a repository entry.
The live maker loaded with an empty canvas before START was pressed; the output was seen only in the example images on the project page.
